description: Retrieve one current eSIM plan by plan_id (from search_plans), including EUR price, coverage destination, data allowance, validity, availability, and purchase terms. Use this to confirm an offer before prepare_order; optional destination must be the exact destination slug to narrow lookup, not a free-text city. A missing or withdrawn plan returns not_found; search_plans again instead of relying on cached prices.

lang.description: Language for names and texts (default en).

plan_id.description: Exact current plan ID from search_plans, not a plan name.

name: get_plan
title: Get plan details
